breaking_changes: Model version format changed from X.Y.Z (e.g. 11.9.0) to YYYY.WW.N (e.g. 2026.39.0) or YYYY.WW.0~<count>.<hash>; tools and scripts that parse --version output or compare version strings need updating.

The /models and /pull/variants API endpoints now serialize registry_source as an empty string instead of 'huggingface' for models without an explicit source override; clients that assume registry_source is always 'huggingface' or 'modelscope' will see '' and may misinterpret it.
The unversioned /docs endpoint subtree now returns a JSON 404 instead of falling through to the SPA web-app; anyone relying on that fallback will receive a 404.

evidence.blockers: Two P0 items: the gpt-oss-120b model loading fix (1f1b482) must verify the correct 63 GB checkpoint is selected, and the registry_source API regression (92037d8-3) must confirm empty-string serialization does not break clients. The new version format (c47aa2a) is also P0 — testers must confirm the date-based version appears correctly in --version output and server logs. The candidate release path has never been exercised end-to-end; the release branch creation workflow and candidate Docker tag need manual validation before shipping.
evidence.breaking_changes: Three user-facing breaking changes ship: the version format shift (X.Y.Z → YYYY.WW.N) affects CLI consumers and any tooling that parses versions; the registry_source empty-string serialization on /models and /pull/variants may break clients assuming a non-empty value; the unversioned /docs subtree now returns JSON 404 instead of SPA fallback. No migration path exists for the version format change — it is a deliberate break documented in the new release.md process. The registry_source change should be noted for clients that enumerate models and expect 'huggingface' as the default source.
evidence.coverage: All 45 commits reviewed. The release spans PRs #2605 through #3600 covering model registry additions, backend version bumps, CI infrastructure overhauls, new API endpoints (docs, session relay, images/edit), security hardening (wildcard origins, vendored asset integrity), build system changes (pkg-config, dynamic versioning), and release process automation (prerelease publishing, candidate Docker tag, scheduled branch creation).
evidence.manual_testing: This release needs verification of new user-reachable surfaces: (1) model loading for gpt-oss-120b-mxfp-GGUF, (2) wildcard origin matching on the allowed_origins config, (3) the new /v1/docs API endpoint and MCP lemonade_docs tool, (4) the /images/edit endpoint with real image data, (5) FLM download from ModelScope with both explicit --source and default config paths, (6) session header relay with a live cloud provider, (7) soft-idle prompt cache preservation with auto_evict enabled, (8) the release branch creation workflow triggered manually, (9) pulling and running the candidate Docker tag, (10) confirming candidate prereleases appear correctly on the GitHub Releases page.
evidence.security: Security hardening in PR #2709 pins the vendored model-viewer bundle to a verified SHA-256 with a CI drift guard. PR #6a5e307 adds wildcard origin matching with strict dot-boundary subdomain enforcement, reviewed by a security maintainer. PR #496bb24 removes the previously undocumented /internal/mcp/* process-launching endpoints, improving security posture. PR #8312c1a uses a strict allowlist for session header relay and deliberately excludes telemetry headers. No other security-relevant concerns observed.
